title: Friendly Wager Set Between Mayor Owens and Town of Durham Admin. Selig
summary: Mayor Sharon F. Owens and Town of Durham Administrator Todd Selig established a friendly wager tied to the Syracuse University vs. University of New Hampshire football game, with the loser's community providing a local specialty (maple syrup or Dinosaur Bar-B-Que). The gesture highlights inter-community engagement and local pride, with both leaders sharing SU alumni credentials.

political_signal.description: Demonstrates mayoral engagement in community-building and inter-jurisdictional relationship strengthening through informal diplomatic gestures tied to shared institutional pride.
